listings.title: Ameritron AL-811H (needs work)
listings.work_flag: Not putting out full rated power — around 400W PEP on a brief test; tubes may be tired; a previous owner replaced a power-supply capacitor and the seller says the work was done very sloppily. Plus shipping (amount not stated; seller warns it will be high).

listings.title: Collins KWM-2A transceiver
listings.work_flag: needs work — band-switch steel cable off its pulleys; receiver works on 80 meters; transmitter untested; offered as is. Seller replaced some electrolytic capacitors; plug-in relay modification fitted

listings.title: Kenwood TS-2000
listings.work_flag: PLL unlock — the synthesizer loses lock and the transmitter shuts down (seller's words: 'unlocked PLL'). No mic included; manual and DC cord are.

listings.title: Kenwood TS-450S (parts unit)
listings.work_flag: Sold for parts, not working — the display reverts to a line of dots; dent in the top cover; the antenna tuner works. The ad title says SALE PENDING, so it may already be spoken for. Plus shipping (about 17 lbs, 48 states only).
